project.title: Microbial community in dynamic of extracellular antimicrobial resistome in a wastewater treatment plant: impact of process configuration and season
project.description: 16S ribosomal RNA of microbial community in conventional activated sludge (CAS) and membrane bioreactors (MBR) at full-scale wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) under varying seasonal conditions.
project.center_name: Faculty of Geosciences and Civil Engineering, Kanazawa University
